 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. NFL Week 11 uniforms: Here are the helmets, jerseys and pants for every team originally appeared on NBC Sports Philadelphia 
 NFL teams are rocking the old and the new in Week 11 .
 Two teams will wear their Rivalries uniforms, including a returning set for the Buffalo Bills and a new one for the Houston Texans. Two other teams, the Washington Commanders and Detroit Lions are going with blackouts.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Beyond the alternates, you'll also see iconic primaries worn by the Dallas Cowboys , San Francisco 49ers and Pittsburgh Steelers, among others
 What are all the uniform matchups for Week 11 ? Here's a game-by-game breakdown.
 Colts vs. Texans
 Colts: White helmets, blue jerseys, white pants
 Texans: White helmets, white jerseys, white pants (Rivalries)
 Cardinals vs. Chiefs
 Cardinals: White helmets, white jerseys, white pants
 Chiefs: Red helmets, red jerseys, TBA pants
 Ravens vs. Panthers
 Ravens: TBA helmets, white jerseys, TBA pants
 Panthers: Silver helmets, black jerseys, TBA pants
 Dolphins vs. Bills
 Dolphins: White helmets, aqua jerseys, TBA pants
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bills: White helmets, white jerseys, white pants (Rivalries)
 Saints vs. Bears
 Saints: Gold helmets, white jerseys, black pants
 Bears: Navy blue helmets, navy blue jerseys, TBA pants
 Buccaneers vs. Lions
 Buccaneers: Pewter helmets, white jerseys, white pants
 Lions: Blue helmets, black jerseys, black pants (alternate)
 Titans vs. Cowboys
 Titans: White helmets, light blue jerseys, light blue pants
 Cowboys: Silver helmets, white jerseys, seafoam pants
 Steelers vs. Eagles
 Steelers: Black helmets, white jerseys, yellow pants
 Eagles: TBA helmets, TBA jerseys, TBA pants
 Jets vs. Chargers
 Jets: Green helmets, white jerseys, green pants
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chargers: White helmets, powder blue jerseys, powder blue pants
 Jaguars vs. Giants
 Jaguars: Black helmets, white jerseys, TBA pants
 Giants: Blue helmets, blue jerseys, white pants
 Raiders vs. Broncos
 Raiders: Silver helmets, white jerseys, silver pants
 Broncos: Navy blue helmets, orange jerseys, TBA pants
 Vikings vs. 49ers
 Vikings: Purple helmets, white jerseys, TBA pants
 49ers: Gold helmets, red jerseys, gold pants
 Bengals vs. Commanders
 Bengals: Orange helmets, white jerseys, white pants
 Commanders: Black helmets, black jerseys, black pants (alternate)
